english: Hugh's special glock that he modified with his own hands way back in the day, he somehow lost it long ago...but here it is in perfect condition ready for killing.
This gas-operated semi-automatic pistol is sure to have zombies wishing they had gone vegan when they see you strapped with one of these.
Marc's custom homemade MP5, he made it at the beginning of the Zombie Apocalypse. Unfortunately Marc didn't make it...he got eaten only a few days after putting the final touches on his MP5.

This old AK-47 commissioned for the Soviet Union's Red Army special forces has somehow made it's way all the way to Arizona. It seems to have belonged to a man named Private Nikola and some...interesting modifications have been made to make it a serious killing machine.
Dan's custom made assault rifle, he made this in his garage before the zombies came and never even got the chance to kill any zombies with it because he was eaten whole by a zombie bear.
Manny's custom made M60 machine gun designed for one reason and one reason only...to mow down the enemies of Manny.
The classic bolt-action that all others aspire to be, one shot of this will rip through just about anything.
Ron made this lever action rifle with his bare hands to be as deadly as possible.
Jen cooked up this sniper in her garage one night when there were a whole lotta zombies coming to eat her...the zombies did not make it.
This shotgun is sure to keep the peace...if anything disturbs your peace it can be restored with only 1 pull of the trigger.
Trader Bob's homemade shotgun with a fire rate faster than a coyote!
This is a normal looking fire axe...if you ignore the glowing green bits that somehow make it stronger.
An axe made for a true barbarian, perfect for cutting down enemies of all sizes.
Trader Rekt originally made this chainsaw to cut down trees but he soon found that it had many other uses...
You can sometimes make out the sound of chilling whispers when wielded.
Someone found a way to modify the stun baton to emit 5x the normal power, some say each strike feels like lightning.
This handy club got Joel through some hard times with it's superior wacking ability.
It doesn't seem very practical but these golden knuckles are suprisingly effective at beating enemies to a pulp!
This massive hammer will destroy anything it comes it comes across with no remorse.
Some dude named Sam put his name on this totally badass spear...sweet!
This pump shotgun will give your enemies something to remember...for the last few seconds of their life.

An old hunter's knife that never stopped hunting. Its wounds keep bleeding long after the cut, it carves extra meat and hide off anything you bring down, and it hits hardest when your prey never sees you coming.\n\n25% chance to cause bleeding. +50% harvest from corpses. Sneak attacks deal 6x damage.

Batter up! This bat swung for the fences in the last game ever played before the outbreak, and it still hasn't lost its touch.\n\nPower attacks send zombies flying and have a 30% chance to knock them down.

A heavy iron sledge with dried blood caked into every groove. Nobody knows who made it, but every swing that lands seems to give a little life back to whoever is holding it.\n\nEach hit heals you 8 health. Kills heal 15 more.

Carved from a tree that burned for forty days and never fell. Arrows loosed from this bow have a habit of bursting into flames when they hit.\n\n35% chance to set targets on fire. Draws and reloads faster than a wooden bow.

A matte black crossbow built by a survivalist who preferred never to be heard. In the right hands it puts down anything that hasn't noticed you yet.\n\nSneak attacks deal 5x damage. Reloads 40% faster than an iron crossbow.

Somebody packed this pipe rifle's ammo box with a little too much extra. Whatever it kills goes out with a bang, so keep your distance.\n\nAnything killed with this rifle explodes, dealing up to 120 damage to everything within 4 meters, including you.
A pipe shotgun some lunatic rigged up with an old freezer compressor. Nobody knows how it works, but anything it hits slows to a crawl.\n\nHits slow enemies by 50% for 4 seconds.

An old prospector's steel pick that has struck more veins than anyone can count. It bites through rock and always seems to turn up a little more ore than you'd expect.\n\n+50% ore and stone from mining. Swings faster and lasts longer than a steel pickaxe.
Chilled to the bone and moving at half speed.

Welded together from scrap during a horde night that never seemed to end. The more it kills, the faster it fires, and the faster you move.\n\nEach kill gives you 6 seconds of +25% fire rate, 20% faster reloads and 15% faster movement. Keep killing to keep it going.

A beat-up pipe pistol with a pair of dice welded to the grip. Most shots are nothing special. Some shots are very, very special.\n\nEvery shot has a 7% chance to hit for up to 7x damage. Holds 7 rounds.
Every kill keeps you going: faster fire rate and reloads with your machine gun and faster movement.
